text_block_list.text:
...The time to make a decision was drawing 
near.

"A final decision had to be made on 
whether Loves Only You would enter the 
Hong Kong International G1 races."

Loves Only You still appears to be 
carrying fatigue from the fierce battle at 
the Queen Elizabeth II Cup. On the other 
hand—

Believing in her recovery, she showed 
strong determination toward the Hong Kong 
expedition.

At the same time, the community members 
also eagerly anticipated her leap onto the 
global stage—

Spreading her wings to the world and 
proving her speed. That is Loves Only 
You's precious dream, and the dream of her 
community members as well.

To bring that dream's progress to a major 
halt based on my own judgment alone. 
Wondering if that was truly the right 
call—

"...I was sure there wasn't a stream 
scheduled for today. Wondering what was 
going on, I went inside—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Ah, there they are.

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"You really came right away!" "Ooh, that 
was fast." "As expected of our 
bridge-builder!" "We've been waiting for 
you~" "Thank you for your hard work." 
"Good work~!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"—Sorry if I startled you. Everyone helped 
me set up this stream."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...There's a favor I want to ask of you 
in front of everyone, Trainer-kun."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...I wanted to ask a favor of you, 
Trainer-chan, in front of everyone.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder, can you hear my voice?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...'I can hear you.' Oh, thank 
goodness...!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: “......Um, you know. Trainer-kun—”

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: “......Um, you know. Trainer-chan—”

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Whatever is troubling you right now... I 
want you to tell me... all of it."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Whatever is troubling you right now... I 
want you to tell me... everything.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, you might not have noticed, 
but... you know, I watch you quite a lot.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, you might not have noticed, 
but... I'm actually watching you quite a 
lot, you know?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I know. ......I just can't 
help but know."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: That you are worrying... for our sake.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
The fact that you're... agonizing over 
things for our sake.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...If it's all right, I'd like you to tell 
me. ...Because I want to think about it 
together with you.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...If it's all right, I'd like you to tell 
me. ...Because I want to think about it 
together with you.

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"We'll listen too!" "Don't be a stranger~" 
"Don't bottle it all up alone!" "We're 
comrades!" "Our motto is mutual support 
and love!" "Rely on us more!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're right♪ Helping and supporting 
each other is what we're all about.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer-kun. ...I'll be waiting right 
here, okay?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer-chan. ...I'll be waiting right 
here, okay?
—Closing the stream, I break into a run.

"All so the feelings that Loves Only You 
and the Commu-members extended to me would 
not go to waste."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun...! Fufu, you ran all the way 
here for me.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan...! Fufu, you ran all the way 
here for me.

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"She's here!" "So fast (lol" "Good work!" 
"Alright, let's hear what she has to say." 
"Kinda nervous." "Big moment."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
All right everyone, I'll leave the audio 
on just like this, so let's listen to the 
story together.

I bow deeply. To Loves Only You. To the 
committee members who are listening to my 
story.

...For not being able to speak until you 
set up a place for me like this.

"And for the deep despair that what I am 
about to say will bring—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
choice_data_list:
......I think we should hold off on the 
Hong Kong expedition

text_block_list.text:
And so, with the commu members listening 
in, I kept my eyes fixed on Loves Only You 
and laid bare everything on my mind.

The possibility of not fully recovering 
from the fatigue of the QEII Cup. Plus the 
risk of a first overseas expedition. The 
worst-case scenario those could bring 
about...

Yet, watching everyone pursue their 
dreams, even at this late hour, I find 
myself hesitating to make the decision...

And above all, the guilt that I was the 
one who suggested the overseas campaign to 
Loves Only You in the first place...

"I'll speak honestly about every single 
one of those things. ...For the sake of 
Loves Only You, who set up this 
opportunity, and for everyone else――"
choice_data_list:
...I'm truly sorry for waiting so long to 
tell you.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.text:
Neither I nor anyone else thinks you did 
anything you need to apologize for... not 
in the slightest, you know?

text_block_list.text:
"If anything, I'm the one who should 
apologize. After all... I was the one who

Trainer-chan."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'm a bit impatient. Just thinking 
about reaching the world stage makes me 
lean in a little too eager...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...What you're feeling, Trainer-kun, is 
love.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Trainer-chan, that's what you call love.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
You've always... treasured them, haven't 
you? Our feelings, that is.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Not wanting to hurt my dreams or my 
members' dreams, trying to cherish and 
protect them, you worried and agonized 
over it so, so much—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
A love that treasures everyone more than 
herself—larger than this very sky.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer-kun. For loving my 
dream, and everyone else's.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer-chan. For loving my

Look♪ Everyone understands how you feel 
too♡

text_block_list.text:
"So kind..." "Thanks for the 
consideration!" "Maybe I got a bit too 
carried away, my bad." "Always keeping a 
level head—that's our Trainer for you!"

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry about it~!" "Safety first!" 
"Loves-chan is right." "GJ being the 
bridge!" "You did nothing wrong!" "You did 
great, honestly."

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Gym Bro
text_block_list.text:
"What matters most to us is her happiness. 
Ms. Bridge, you haven't done anything 
wrong."

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
"We got a little ahead of ourselves too, 
getting all worked up alongside 
Loves-chan. Thanks to your bridge, we 
finally realized it. Thank you!"

...I can feel it. The feelings of my 
community members from each and every 
comment.

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry about it!" "Let's do our best 
next time!" "It's not over yet!" "It 
starts from here!" "We still have Dubai!" 
"On to the next one!"

text_block_list.name: Hardworker@Overseas Assignment
text_block_list.text:
""Alright, our main target is Dubai! Show 
them your absolute best run, Loves-chan!""

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...That's love, isn't it?

...And with everyone in agreement, it was 
decided to pass on the Hong Kong trip—

...That night, we held a meeting to 
reconsider and decide on her upcoming 
rotation.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—So, with next year's Dubai International 
G1 as our primary goal, we'll start making 
adjustments now♪

text_block_list.text:
The Kyoto Kinen is a GII middle-distance 
turf race over 2,200 meters held at Kyoto 
Racecourse in February.

This race is frequently chosen as the 
season debut for Senior-class Umamusume 
setting their sights on the big races of 
the first half of the year.
